newsitem.title: CROATIA: Demand, London bolster Croatian Pliva, Zagrebacka.
newsitem.headline: Demand, London bolster Croatian Pliva, Zagrebacka.

text.p: Stronger investor demand and higher prices in London bolstered the prices of Croatian blue chips Pliva and Zagrebacka Banka on Tuesday, traders said.
Pliva rose to 485 kuna with around 1,000 shares traded by 1030 GMT on Zagreb's bourse, from 470 at close last Friday.
Zagrebacka's ordinaries firmed 10 kuna to 1,960 though at smaller volume of 300-400 units.
"Buying is more lively but sellers are still reluctant to lower prices," said one trader with a large market share.
Pliva's 1/5 GDRs rose to $16.125 from Monday's close of 16.06 on the London Stock Exchange.

Zagrebacka's GDRs, issued at 10 to each share, last fetched $32.5, down from $32.495 at the open on London's Seaq. They closed at $32.25 each on Monday. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
